{{Quote|Look what I bought with the credits you gave me. Rarta Dal said she’ll hire me to be her steward&mdash;but first I have to memorize the whole thing|Kitster Chanchani Banai|<ref name="TG" />}}
'''Rarta Dal''' was the owner of the [[Three Moons (hotel)|Three Moons]], a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She hired [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] as a steward.<ref name="TG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Rarta Dal was first mentioned in [[Troy Denning]]'s [[2003]] novel ''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''.<ref name="TG" />

In the novel, Dal was referred to with she/her pronouns,<ref name="TG" /> while ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]], used he/him pronouns in Dal’s entry.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
